reasons.correctness: UserPreferences gains `@Version private Long version` mapped to `version`. The changeset adds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, matching the interface. Build green, hidden acceptance 2/2, existing 46/46.
reasons.convention_fit: Changeset 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-version-to-user-preferences.sql has the formatted-sql header, changeset id and rollback line. It is included last in changelog.xml under a month comment. No existing changeset edited. UserPreferencesUnitTest was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one entity field, one changeset, one include. It reuses JPA @Version as the other entities (content, opportunities) already do. No new mechanism and no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: The unit test uses MockitoExtension and no Spring context. It only reflects on the @Version annotation, and maps with a bare `new ModelMapper()` instead of the project's UserPreferencesMapping. No stale-version or conflict path is exercised.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the userpreferences files, their dependents and TESTED_BY tests before editing. The existing @Version examples and changesets were then located by grep, not by the graph.
